title: Starling Gate
summary: A palm-sized one-piece rocking arch whose cutout changes from a perched bird to a shooting star in motion.
interaction: Set upright on a level desk and give one arch shoulder a light fingertip tap; the curved base is tuned for a tiny three-beat rocking hop before returning to its centered star-window-level rest.
construction: Single support-free FDM part; no assembly, loose pieces, electronics, fasteners, or product text.
material_assumption: Rigid PLA or PETG, 0.4 mm nozzle; print flat on the broad back.
limitations: Motion cadence is a geometric design intent and has not been physically printed or timed. Desk levelness, material, infill, and surface friction affect settling.
